_comment: Mystic Instant: it resolves when PLAYED, so ability_type is PLAY — it was TRIGGERED/ON_ATTACK and never fired. 'Transcend' is the CR 8.5.48 keyword (TRANSCEND effect); it was modelled as TRANSFORM_HERO {hero: 'Transcend'}, which is the Arakni Agent-of-Chaos transform and unrelated (the 'hero' param is not even read). 'ANOTHER blue card' is count 2, since playing this card records a blue play itself.
